items.summary: Update miscDeps to brlapi bindings built against the limited Python API (#20965)
items.fullMessage:
Update miscDeps to brlapi bindings built against the limited Python API (#20965)

None. Merges nvaccess/nvda-misc-deps#50.
Summary of the issue:

NVDA bundles the brlapi Python module from miscDeps. That module is built for one Python version, so each Python minor version update needs a new build from the NV Access fork of BRLTTY. Upstream BRLTTY can now build the module against Python's limited API (brltty/brltty#570).
Description of user facing changes:

None
Description of developer facing changes:

The brlapi Python module is now built from upstream BRLTTY instead of the NV Access fork. It works with multiple Python versions.
Description of development approach:

    Updated the miscDeps submodule to the latest commit. It replaces brlapi.cp313-win_amd64.pyd with brlapi.pyd, built against the limited API from BRLTTY commit 34571edfcbe2d47a952fcab58587a9fa46b6e29e. It also updates brlapi-0.8.dll.
    Updated the brlapi entry in the run time dependencies of the developer documentation.

items.summary: Align Unicode data and refine language processing
items.fullMessage:
Align Unicode data and refine language processing

- Updates Unicode script ranges and character classifications to Unicode 17.0 and CLDR 48.2.
- Normalizes mathematical alphanumeric symbols across all styles (bold, italic, script, fraktur, double-struck, sans-serif, monospace) into plain text for speech and voice dictionary lookup.
- Clusters adjacent numbers with currency symbols, measurement units, and time indicators to prevent awkward mid-expression pauses.
- Preserves UTS #51 emoji sequences and modifiers intact across multilingual boundaries.
- Allows NVDA language reporting and symbol dictionaries when automatic language profiles are off, while keeping voice switching strictly prevented at the driver level.
